Subject: Thanks for signing up — choose a demo type

Hi Samir,

Thanks for creating a trial account with Redwood Inference — welcome! A few quick paths to get you started; pick whichever fits your team: 

• Product overview (30 min) — high-level walkthrough for PMs and execs: feature set, pricing model, and migration patterns.
• Technical deep-dive (45 min) — hands-on session with an infra engineer to cover model routing, latency SLOs, and deployment options.
• Self-serve (no demo) — proceed with the trial; we’ll surface tips in-app.

Pick a slot directly: product: https://cal.com/redwood/product-overview-30 or technical: https://cal.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive-45. If you prefer an SDR to coordinate, reply and we’ll introduce someone.

Pre-demo checklist attached: trial-checklist.pdf (short checklist for connectivity, API key, and sample payloads).

Cheers,
The Redwood Trials Team

--
Redwood Inference
https://www.redwood.ai

Hi Samir — welcome and congrats on the trial sign-up. I’m Ben on the SDR team; I work with Rishi and the solutions group. I saw you picked up the trial this morning — if it helps, we can run either a short product walkthrough or a technical deep-dive.

Two quick options that people tend to choose:
- Product walkthrough — 30 minutes, covers product capabilities, roadmap fit, and success metrics. Pick here: https://cal.com/redwood/product-overview-30
- Technical deep-dive — 45 minutes, includes KV cache, batching strategies, and ops checklist (Rishi will join). Pick here: https://cal.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive-45

If neither of those times work, tell me a couple of windows that do and I’ll propose alternatives. I’ve attached a brief intake form that helps tailor the demo to your stack: pre-demo-intake-form.docx.

Thanks — happy to coordinate the invite.

Best,

3) 10m — recommended rollout patterns (dedicated vs hosted) and cost levers
4) 5m — next steps and any follow-ups
